body.aakriti_basis: Aakriti means a shape and the many of these yogas are based on the shape of the arrangement of planets in a chart.
body.aakriti_nodes_note: In all these yogas, Rahu and Ketu are not counted as planets by many authors.
body.aakriti_order_differs: §11.5's classification lists Sringaataka before Vihangama; §11.5.3 defines Vihanga before Sringaataka.
body.aakriti_reading_rule: Where a definition's subject is “all the planets”, the test is that every planet lies in the named houses. Where the subject is a house — “lagna and the 7th houses are occupied by natural benefics” — that house must be occupied.
body.aasraya_basis: Aasraya yogas are based on the signs occupied by planets. If all the planets are in movable signs or in fixed signs or in dual signs, these yogas arise.
body.adhi_example_note: Section 11.3.6's example places the Moon in Taurus and the benefics in Virgo and Leo, which are the 5th and 4th from Taurus. The rule asks for the 6th, 7th and 8th. The rule is followed.
body.advanced_raaja_input_note: These seventeen reach past signs — into chara karakas, the navamsa, the divisional lagnas, HL and GL. A chart that cannot decide one of them gets a verdict whose reason begins “this yoga cannot be decided”, never a bare absence. Supply longitudes for the karaka and varga yogas, a lagna longitude for yogas 7 and 9, and HL and GL for yogas 6 and 8.
body.advanced_raaja_intro: Some advanced Raaja Yogas will be listed below.
body.arudha_effectiveness_note: Section 11.7.3 (18) is not a combination — it says how effective the chart’s Raaja yogas are. It is returned by /v1/planetary-yoga/raaja-magnitude beside the yogas and never among them.
body.arudha_effectiveness_rule: If arudha lagna and darapada (arudha pada of the 7th house) are not in mutual 2nd/12th or 6th/8th positions, then Raja Yogas in the chart will be more effective.
body.brahma_variation: If (1) Jupiter is in a quadrant from the 9th lord, (2) Venus is in a quadrant from the 11th lord, and, (3) Mercury is in a quadrant from the 1st lord or 10th lord, then this yoga is present.
body.brahma_variation_note: NOTE (2) gives a second, unrelated definition of Brahma yoga. The first one — benefics in the 4th, 10th and 11th from lagna lord — is the one detected; the variation is carried here so a caller can see it was not silently dropped.
body.chandra_intro: Chandra yogas are the lunar combinations. There are several yogas based on Moon.
body.combustion_is_a_qualifier_not_a_veto: Section 11.2.4 says a yoga formed by a combust planet loses “some of their power to do good”, not all of it. A combust yoga is therefore reported as present with a qualifier, never suppressed.
body.combustion_note: If Mercury is too close to Sun, he is combust (asta or astangata). Yogas formed by combust planets lose some of their power to do good.

conclusion.text: A lot of combinations and results have been given in this chapter. Readers are advised to read more literature and practice yogas on real charts. One should be able to find with a quick glance the yogas present in a chart. Experience certainly helps there. In the rest of this book, we will see some examples of yogas.

When looking at the results ascribed to various yogas, try to fit them in today's world. For example, one with Kamala yoga may not really become a king, but probably become the Prime Minister of a nation or the Governor of a state. When using yogas in divisional charts, adapt the results to the matters signified by the chart.

All the great results ascribed to some yogas may not materialize in reality, due to weaknesses in them. Unless a yoga is very strong, all the results cannot expected. Just one yoga cannot make or break a personality, unless it is very powerful.
In the case of yogas with many conditions, partial results may sometimes be experienced if all the conditions are not satisfied.

body.daridra_general_principles: Dusthanas (6th, 8th and 12th) and their lords are detrimental to wealth. If lagna, lagna lord and trine lords are afflicted by them, one may be poor. Conjunction or aspect of marakas clinches the issue. However, conjunction or aspect of trine lords is a saving factor. In addition, the planets in the 2nd house and the strength of 2nd lord matter.
body.daridra_intro: One experiences poverty if the following yogas (combinations) are present in one's chart:
body.daridra_saving_factor: However, conjunction or aspect of trine lords is a saving factor.
body.deep_exaltation_note: Jaya and Vidyut require a planet in “deep exaltation”. The book gives the exact exaltation degree but no tolerance around it, so neither yoga is ever reported present: when the planet is not in his exaltation sign the verdict is a definite absence, and when he is, the verdict names his distance from the exact degree and says the depth is undecided. See docs/open-items.md OI-83.
body.dhana_basic_principle: The 5th and 9th lords and planets joining them are capable of giving money. They give dasas in their dasas. The 11th house is also important for material gains and it should be strong. The 2nd house is also important. If Moon, Mercury, Jupiter or Venus is exalted in the 2nd house, it makes the native very rich.

Aq.first: If Mercury is in the 5th house and Moon, Mars and Jupiter are in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Aq.second: If Saturn occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mars and Jupiter, then also one becomes very rich.

Ar.first: If Sun is in the 5th house and Saturn, Moon and Jupiter are in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Ar.second: If Mars occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mercury, Venus and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.

Cn.first: If Mars is in the 5th house and Venus is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Cn.second: If Moon occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mercury and Jupiter, then also one becomes very rich.

Cp.first: If Venus is in the 5th house and Mars is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Cp.second: If Saturn occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mars and Jupiter, then also one becomes very rich.

Ge.first: If Venus is in the 5th house and Mars is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Ge.second: If Mercury occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Jupiter and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.

Le.first: If Jupiter is in the 5th house and Mercury is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Le.second: If Sun occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mars and Jupiter, then also one becomes very rich.

Li.first: If Saturn is in the 5th house and Sun and Moon are in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Li.second: If Venus occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mercury and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.

Pi.first: If Moon is in the 5th house and in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Pi.second: If Jupiter occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mars and Mercury, then also one becomes very rich.

Sc.first: If Jupiter is in the 5th house and Mercury is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Sc.second: If Mars occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mercury, Venus and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.

Sg.first: If Mars is in the 5th house and Venus is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Sg.second: If Jupiter occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mars and Mercury, then also one becomes very rich.

Ta.first: If Mercury is in the 5th house and Moon, Mars and Jupiter are in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Ta.second: If Venus occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mercury and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.

Vi.first: If Saturn is in the 5th house and Sun and Moon are in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
Vi.second: If Mercury occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Jupiter and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.

body.dhana_exalted_in_second_rule: If Moon, Mercury, Jupiter or Venus is exalted in the 2nd house, it makes the native very rich.
body.dhana_intro: Dhana means wealth. Dhana yogas are combinations that give one abundant riches.
body.dhana_parasara_note: In addition to these general principles, Parasara listed specific combinations for various lagnas. In all these combinations, the strength of the participating planets decides the magnitude of results experienced.
body.dhana_pisces_note: Entry (12) names no planet for the 11th house, so no chart can satisfy it and it is reported undecidable. The other eleven all name the 11th lord there, which for Pisces lagna is Saturn — recorded as an inference and not applied. See docs/book-deviations.md D-37.
body.dhana_pisces_printed: If Moon is in the 5th house and in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
body.dhana_printed_oddity: They give dasas in their dasas.

dhana_results.second: then also one becomes very rich

body.dhana_results_note: Section 11.9 prints each combination’s outcome at the end of its own sentence rather than as a separate Results paragraph. The two are uniform across all twelve entries.
dhana_structure: the first combination always places the 5th lord in the 5th house
the planets it wants in the 11th always include the 11th lord
the second combination always places the lagna lord in lagna
body.dhana_structure_note: Section 11.9's twelve entries are not twelve unrelated rules. Checked against all twelve lagnas rather than assumed: every first combination places the 5th lord in the 5th house, the planets it wants in the 11th always include the 11th lord, and every second combination places the lagna lord in lagna. That is what ties them to the Basic Principle above.
body.dhana_two_combinations_note: Each entry carries two independent combinations — the second introduced with “then also” — so they are registered as twenty-four, and a caller is told which of the two a chart has. A combination belongs to one lagna; on any other the verdict names both lagnas rather than reporting a bare absence.
body.dharma_karmadhipati_reason: The 9th house is the most important trine and the 10th house is the most important quadrant. Raja yoga involving the lords of these two houses is excellent.
body.divisional_yoga_note: Section 6.5 already maps a matter to a chart; this is the same instruction run the other way — a yoga found in D-10 is read against what D-10 signifies, not against life at large. The `chart` field on every response records which chart the verdict came from.
body.divisional_yoga_rule: When using yogas in divisional charts, adapt the results to the matters signified by the chart.
body.frequency_note: Because Mercury and Venus are with Sun or a sign away from him most of the time, the following yogas are very common in rasi chart. However, they are less common in divisional charts. One can apply these yogas in D-9 and D-10 in particular.
body.hamsa_name_note: Section 11.4.5's Definition calls the yoga “Ruchaka”, which is Mars's yoga from section 11.4.1. The heading reads “Hamsa Yoga” and is followed — see docs/book-deviations.md D-30.

kalpadruma_example.conclusion: Thus we get the four planets as — Sun, Saturn, Venus and Saturn. Sun is in a quadrant. Saturn is exalted. Venus is in a trine. Thus Shivaji had Kalpadruma yoga. In navamsa also, Sun is exalted, Saturn is in moolatrikona and Venus is in a lagna.
kalpadruma_example.navamsa_lagna_note: Chart 9's own navamsa diagram puts Venus in Gemini and the navamsa lagna in Sagittarius, so she is in the 7th from it, not in it. Our D-9 reproduces all ten of that diagram's placements. Nothing in the yoga turns on the claim. See docs/book-deviations.md D-34.
kalpadruma_example.walkthrough: As an example, let us look at the rasi and navamsa charts of Chatrapati Shivaji, a great king of India (see Chart 9). Lagna lord is Sun. He is in Aq and his dispositor is Saturn (lord of Aq). Saturn is in Li and his dispositor is Venus. We also need Saturn's dispositor in navamsa. In navamsa, Saturn is in Aq and his dispositor is Saturn himself.

body.kamala_modern_reading: one with Kamala yoga may not really become a king, but probably become the Prime Minister of a nation or the Governor of a state
body.kartari_definition: Kartari literally means “scissors”. The 12th and 2nd houses from a house cast kartari on it. If the 2nd and 12th from a house have benefics, it is said to have a subha (benefic) kartari. Malefics in the same places cause paapa (malefic) kartari.
body.kartari_effect: Subha kartari on any house does good to the matters of that house and paapa kartari does harm.
body.kartari_is_general: Subha kartari and paapa kartari are also known as “subha kartari yoga” and “paapa kartari yoga” and they can be seen with reference to any house or planet.
body.kartari_note: Both flanks must carry the same nature — footnote 31 reads “the 2nd and 12th” — so a benefic on one side and a malefic on the other is neither subha nor paapa kartari.
body.kemadruma_effort_note: One with this yoga has to work hard and succeed through great efforts.
body.kemadruma_is_a_qualifier_not_a_veto: Section 11.3.4 says Kemadruma kills the *results* of other good yogas, not the yogas themselves. A yoga forming beside it is reported present with a qualifier, never suppressed.
body.kemadruma_kills_other_yogas: This bad yoga kills the results of other good yogas in the chart, especially Chandra yogas.
body.lagnaadhi_gloss: Adhi means over or above. We have already seen Adhi Yoga among Chandra yogas. Lagnaadhi yoga means Adhi Yoga from lagna.
body.lagnaadhi_note: Section 11.6 says Lagnaadhi yoga “means Adhi Yoga from lagna”, but its definition takes only the 7th and 8th, where section 11.3.6’s Adhi takes the 6th, 7th and 8th from Moon. The definition is followed. See docs/book-deviations.md D-35.
body.mahapurusha_element_role: Pancha mahapurusha yogas produce five kinds of great persons with one of these 5 elements playing a predominant role in their personalities.
body.mahapurusha_element_rulers: Mars, Mercury, Saturn, Venus and Jupiter (respectively) represent these 5 elements.
body.mahapurusha_intro: Pancha mahapurusha yogas give the combinations that produce 5 kinds of great persons.
body.mahapurusha_reference_rule: This yoga does not apply from Moon and it applies mainly in rasi chart.
body.maraka_confirms_chapter_7_label: Section 11.10 is the first place the book defines maraka, and it gives the 2nd and 7th — which is what charts/bhava.py had been carrying from general classical knowledge. That closes OI-23.
body.maraka_note: The 2nd and 7th houses are maraka (killer houses). Their lords are marakas (killers). Any malefics occupying 2nd and 7th or associating with 2nd and 7th lords also become malefics.
body.maraka_note_circular_clause: Any malefics occupying 2nd and 7th or associating with 2nd and 7th lords also become malefics.
body.maraka_reading_note: The NOTE’s third sentence reads “any malefics … also become malefics”, which is circular; in context it must be “marakas”. Presence is decided on the base set alone — the 2nd and 7th lords, which the NOTE states without ambiguity — because these are poverty combinations and a false present is worse than a false absent. Every affected verdict reports what the wider reading would add and whether it would change the answer. See docs/open-items.md OI-96.
body.mutual_drishti_is_both_ways_note: Association (2) reads “aspect **each other** with graha drishti”. Graha drishti is not symmetric — Saturn’s 3rd and 10th, Mars’s 4th and 8th and Jupiter’s 5th and 9th are one-sided — so one planet aspecting the other is not an association here.

naabhasa_classification.basis: the natures of the planets occupying the quadrants

body.naabhasa_gap_note: Section 11.5 classifies 32 Naabhasa yogas and sections 11.5.1 to 11.5.4 define every one. Nothing is pending. They are listed here rather than registered, so that a yoga the engine cannot detect never appears among the verdicts where its absence would read as a finding.
body.naabhasa_intro: Naabhasa yogas are classified celestial combinations.
body.naabhasa_timing_rule: Results of other yogas may be felt primarily during the dasas of the planets and signs involved. But the results of Naabhasa yogas are felt in all dasas.
body.no_single_yoga_decides: Just one yoga cannot make or break a personality, unless it is very powerful.
body.node_note: Three of the four Ravi yogas turn on “a planet other than Moon”. Chapter 11 never says whether Rahu and Ketu count as “a planet”, so it is a per-call choice and the nodes are excluded by default. See docs/open-items.md OI-73.
body.parivartana_footnote: That means that the 2nd lord is in the 10th house and the 10th lord is in the 2nd house. Exchange is called “parivartana” in Sanskrit.
body.partial_results_note: Section 11.11 licenses every partial this chapter already reports rather than hides: section 11.6’s fullness rule, section 11.7.3 (1)’s half-satisfied condition, section 11.5.2’s weakened Dala clause, section 11.2.4’s combustion and section 11.3.4’s Kemadruma. A partial is always a qualifier on a verdict, never a present.
body.partial_results_rule: In the case of yogas with many conditions, partial results may sometimes be experienced if all the conditions are not satisfied.
body.popular_fullness_rule: Sometimes the results of a dasa may be felt even if all the required combinations are not present. But, for a yoga to be fully present, all the required combinations must be present and the participating planets must be strong.
body.popular_intro: Some other important combinations will be listed below.
body.popular_strength_note: Section 11.6 requires the participating planets to be strong for the yoga to be fully present. Strength is not computed — chapter 15's simple-rules measure is not built — so this verdict reports the combinations only.
body.raaja_association_rule: If the lord of a quadrant and the lord of a trine have one of the three kinds of associations mentioned above, it forms a Raaja Yoga. Lagna can be taken as a quadrant or a trine here. It is both.

raaja_associations.text: The two planets aspect each other with graha drishti, or,

The two planets have a parivartana (exchange). For example, if the 4th lord is in the 5th house and the 5th lord is in the 4th house, then we say that there is a parivartana between the 4th and 5th lords. This is an association.

body.raaja_basic_premise: In any chart, Lord Vishnu sits in the quadrants and Goddess Lakshmi sits in the trines. If the lord of a quadrant is associated with the lord of a trine, that association brings the combined blessings of Lakshmi and Vishnu. This is called a Raaja Yoga. The native is powerful and prosperous.

raaja_definitions.dharma_karmadhipati: This is a special case of the above yoga. If the lords of dharma sthana (9th) and karma sthana (10th) form a raja yoga, it is known by this special name.
raaja_definitions.raaja_basic: If the lord of a quadrant and the lord of a trine have one of the three kinds of associations mentioned above, it forms a Raaja Yoga. Lagna can be taken as a quadrant or a trine here. It is both.
raaja_definitions.vipareeta_raaja: The 6th, 8th and 12th houses are known as trik sthanas or dusthanas (bad houses). If their lords occupies dusthanas or conjoin dusthanas, it results in this yoga.

body.raaja_intro: Raaja means a king. Raaja yogas are the combinations that give power and prosperity to a native. They make one the best in something.
body.raaja_lagna_note: “Lagna can be taken as a quadrant or a trine here. It is both.” So the lagna lord is counted on both sides of every pairing.
body.raaja_orb_footnote: Anything greater than 5 or 6 degrees is too large for a Raaja Yoga to give its full results.
body.raaja_sambandha_are_common: However, these yogas are very common.
body.raaja_sambandha_intro: Raaja means a king. Sambandha means relation or association. Raaja sambandha yogas are the combinations that give association with rulers. Those who have these yogas are typically powerful ministers, secretaries, counsellors and bureaucrats, associated with the rulers and powerful men. However, these yogas are very common. The magnitude of success depends on the strength of the planets involved in raja yoga.
body.raaja_sambandha_magnitude_rule: The magnitude of success depends on the strength of the planets involved in raja yoga.
body.raaja_sambandha_note: Section 11.8 warns about itself before listing one: “these yogas are very common”. Every verdict in the group carries that sentence and the section’s own pointer back to section 11.7.2, so a present verdict here is never read as weighing the same as one from section 11.7.
body.ravi_intro: Ravi yogas are the solar combinations. There are several yogas based on Sun.
body.results_note: The results each yoga gives are PVR's own prose and are withheld from this response under the licence gate of OI-12.
body.sankhya_basis: Sankhya yogas are based on the number of distinct signs occupied by the seven planets combined. Rahu and Ketu are not included.
body.sankhya_excludes_nodes: Rahu and Ketu are not included.
body.sankhya_is_a_fallback: These yogas apply if no other Naabhasa yogas mentioned previously are applicable in a chart. These are the least important of all Naabhasa yogas.
body.sankhya_unreachable_note: Taken as stated, section 11.5.4's fallback rule makes Gola and Yuga permanently absent: one or two distinct signs always fit inside a seven-sign window, and section 11.5.3's run yogas cover all twelve windows, so one of them always applies first. Both are still defined and evaluated, and their verdicts name what superseded them. See docs/open-items.md OI-79.
body.sarpa_is_very_bad: This is a very bad combination.
body.sun_excluded_note: The Sun cannot form a yoga about what accompanies him, so he is excluded from his own houses alongside the Moon.

timing_example.text: Suppose someone has Sun and Mercury together in Leo in D-10. Then that person has a powerful Budha-Aditya yoga in career. The results will be felt throughout one's life and the periods of Sun, Mercury and Leo will give those results in particular.

body.trimurthi_note: Some authors combine Hari yoga, Hara yoga and Brahma yoga and call it “Hari Hara Brahma yoga”. Also, these three yogas are known as Trimurthi Yogas. Brahma is the Creator; Hari is the Sustainer; and, Shiva is the Destroyer. They form the Trinity of Gods (Trimurthis).
body.vargottamaamsa_definition: A planet is in vargottamaamsa if it occupies the same sign in Rasi and Navamsa charts.
body.vasumati_reference_note: Vasumati says only “benefics occupy upachayas”, naming no reference and no count. Houses are counted from lagna, as everywhere else in section 11.6, and one benefic in an upachaya is enough; a verdict says how many benefics sit outside them so a stricter reading stays available. See docs/open-items.md OI-84.
body.vipareeta_ideal_case: In the ideal case, the lords of the 6th, 8th and 12th houses will all be together in one of the three houses (or the 3rd house or the 11th house), with no other planets conjoining them. But the results of this yoga may be experienced with just one or two dusthana lords occupying a dusthana.
body.vipareeta_ideal_note: The ideal case names the 3rd and the 11th, which are not dusthanas. Three dusthana lords heaped there occupy no dusthana but do conjoin one another, which is why the second clause of the definition — “or conjoin dusthanas” — is tested alongside the first. See docs/open-items.md OI-86.
body.vipareeta_reason: Because dusthanas show the obstacles one faces in life, situation of dusthana lords in dusthanas shows that obstacles will run into obstacles themselves. One experiences tremendous success in the face of obstacles.
body.weakened_yoga_is_not_applicable: A yoga the book says “may not operate well” does not count as applicable for section 11.5.4's fallback. Lord Sri Rama's chart forces this: its only earlier Naabhasa yoga is a weakened Sarpa, and the book gives the chart as Daama.
body.whole_list_note: “Just one yoga cannot make or break a personality” is why /v1/planetary-yoga/chart returns every yoga’s verdict rather than a headline. Nothing is ranked or summarised for the caller.

worked_charts.note: Given as a Hindu calendar date and a time measured from sunrise, so it is transcribed, not recomputed.

worked_charts.birth_footnote: Birthdata: December 4, 1542, 3:39 am (LMT), 69 E 47, 25 N 19. This date may be written by some as November 24, 1542 based on the old calendar.
worked_charts.note: Footnote 39 settles the calendar: 24 November 1542 in the old calendar is 4 December 1542 in the new, ten days apart, and the printed date is the new one.
worked_charts.shows: the magnitude of a Raaja yoga

body.yogakaraka_note: For six lagnas — Taurus, Cancer, Leo, Libra, Capricorn and Aquarius — one planet lords a quadrant and a trine that are different houses. Section 11.7.1 asks for an association between two planets and says nothing about one planet holding both sides, so the engine reports the fact as a qualifier and draws no conclusion. See docs/open-items.md OI-85.
